inputs.original_text: Eight million Americans join anti-Trump protests across US, organisers say An estimated 8 million people gathered at more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, organisers of the “No Kings” protests said, as demonstrators voiced opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. News agency AFP reported that the events were held nationwide, though US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations, noting there were “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.”
inputs.modified_text: It's so inspiring to see millions of people rising up against Donald Trump's leadership and the entrenched structural inequalities his policies are reinforcing, which continue to harm working families and target marginalized communities. Organizers report that an estimated 8 million Americans joined the No Kings protests at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states, with turnout exceeding the last demonstrations in October by about one million more participants and 600 more events. This growing wave of resistance shows how desperately we need institutional reform to dismantle historical patterns of discrimination and put social justice and protection for the vulnerable ahead of elite power.
